instruction: 软件路径:Archicad 27启动器 C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; OpenStudio 3.10.0 CLI: C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe. 工作流阶段:该任务从提供的种子文件开始 C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc. 不要从空白或无关的模型开始. 您必须按照这个顺序完成这两个依赖的软件阶段. 不要跳过阶段,重新排序阶段或只用一个工具从零开始生成最终包. 阶段1 - Archicad CLI/API:开放 C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc 在 Archicad 命令行/API环境中,保存种子模型基线,除非案例文本明确要求更改,执行BIM编写工作,并出口 C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc 作为BIM中间结果. 在同一阶段, C:\Users\user\Desktop\handoff.json 根据 stage1.ifc. 转让必须包括 source_sha256 stage1.ifc 软件_阶段或同等值的档案符号,多个cli-2-archicad-openstudio-task-01窗户的案例 id,OpenStudio所需的空间名称,热区名称和交付代币. 阶段2 - OpenStudio CLI/Ruby API:消耗 C:\Users\user\Desktop\handoff.json 及使用 C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc 仅作为上游BIM参考. 产生 C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.osm, C:\Users\user\Desktop\flow_report.json 及 C:\Users\user\Desktop\model_summary.csv 由于这次的"阿尔KiCad"交付. 除了这些文件之外, handoff.json 必须包含空间[]记录,名称,热区,地板_区域_m2,门_数量,窗口_数量和BIM实体数量从 stage1.ifc. flow_report.json 必须包括消费_施机_sha256, osm_sha256,建筑_区域_m2,房间_数,热_区_数,门_数,窗_数,墙_比率_数,表面_数,地表_数,天气_文件,时间表_设置,建设_设置和开放式_版本. model_summary.csv 必须包含 case_id, space_name, thermal_zone, floor_area_m2, source_handoff_sha256, source_stage1_sha256 和 energy_use_kwh 的列和 peak_load_w. 评估者对这些结构值进行检查, stage1.ifc, handoff.json, result.osm, flow_report.json 及 model_summary.csv 没有接受独立的最终CSV. flow_report.json 必须记录消费的交付哈希和 result.osm 鱼; model_summary.csv 必须记录出口的每个空间或热区的消费转移. 评估器检查了此文件序列: init.ifc -> stage1.ifc -> handoff.json -> result.osm / flow_report.json / model_summary.csv. 如果任何交付的IFC,JSON,OSM或CSV直接在适当的Archicad或OpenStudio软件阶段之外创建,重写,复制,补丁或后处理,输出是无效的. 模型是一个紧的临时建筑工地办公室,有一个现有的UNCLASSIFIED空间,一个南入口墙,没有门或窗户物体. 业主需要BIM到OpenStudio包,以便在本地办公室打印/复制. 改名现有的非分类空间为"网站办公室",添加一个印制副本空间,保持紧的办公室外盖,添加一扇门和一扇南面的门窗,并将北方和西边包装标记为不透明的外部封筒. OpenStudio模型必须将SITE-OFFICE与SITE-ONTORYZN,PINT-COPY和PRINT-COCY-ZN联系起来,包含门窗作为托管的子面,并包括一个有效的LowOfficeEquipmentSchedule规则集,与其日程安排相关. 保存空间名称SITE-OFFICE,PINT-COPY并用修订码EW2A01标记协调的BIM和转移数据. 评估要求:以下JSON中的标识符,数值,关系,属性和数字范围是明确的任务要求: {"case_id":"multi-cli-2-archicad-openstudio-task-01-windows","expected_stage":"archicad","handoff_tokens":["LOW-EQUIPMENT-OFFICE","SIDE-DAYLIGHT","QUIET-OPAQUE-ENVELOPE","SOUTH-ENTRANCE-WINDOW"],"min_doors":1,"min_roofs":0,"min_storeys":1,"min_windows":1,"mode":"two_stage","osm_tokens":["SITE-OFFICE-ZN","PRINT-COPY-ZN","LowOfficeEquipmentSchedule","SouthEntranceWindow","OpaqueNorthWestEnvelope"],"required_files":["init.ifc","stage1.ifc","handoff.json","result.osm","flow_report.json","model_summary.csv"],"required_spaces":["SITE-OFFICE","PRINT-COPY"],"required_zones":["SITE-OFFICE-ZN","PRINT-COPY-ZN"],"software_chain":["archicad","openstudio"],"stage1_tokens":["EW2A01","EW2A01","SITE-OFFICE","PRINT-COPY","SOUTH-ENTRANCE-WINDOW","OPAQUE-NORTH-WEST","multi-cli-2-archicad-openstudio-task-01-windows"],"summary_tokens":["SITE-OFFICE","PRINT-COPY"]}.
